status: source-only method development before any T2, calibration-object, or target-object payload access
claim_boundary: This protocol tests whether eye-in-hand RealSense depth can provide an independently mounted metric anchor for a Kinect-derived Bayesian-PhysTwin state update. It is not confirmation, not a Causal4D result, and not a claim that the two depth families have statistically independent errors.

sensor_roles.primary_predictor: released Kinect point-cloud checkpoint using Kinect cameras 0 and 1
sensor_roles.candidate_observation: Kinect graph registration through frame f-1
sensor_roles.independent_anchor_family: RealSense D405 depth cameras 0 and 1 mounted eye-in-hand
sensor_roles.intervention_evidence: measured force-torque and T_WT/T_WE robot transforms through frame f-1

anchor_contract.extrinsic_convention: per-frame world-to-camera matrix; invert for back-projection
anchor_contract.static_calibration_family: translation-only robust ICP against the allowed template mesh

development_sequence.stage_one: measure source-only RealSense calibration and candidate-regret competence
development_sequence.stage_two: fit and cross-validate one baseline-relative guard on outcome-open development takes
development_sequence.stage_three: freeze code, hashes, hyperparameters, and a T2 outcome-opening command
development_sequence.stage_four: open T2 once only if source competence gates pass

prospective_T2_gate.decision_if_failed: publish the source/T2 result and keep calibration and target objects sealed

forbidden: extracting or listing T2, calibration-object, or target-object payload members before their registered stage
using RealSense frame f to select a prediction for frame f
treating the two eye-in-hand cameras as independent sample-size evidence
using target-mesh error as perception reliability or a candidate-selection feature
changing the method after T2 outcomes are opened
calling source-only development a state-of-the-art result
